title: जल हौज - Jal Hauz Construction Subsidy Scheme

benefits_as_displayed.all_farmer_categories: 60% of unit cost or maximum INR 90000, whichever is lower

eligibility_summary: Minimum 0.5 hectare cultivable agricultural land in the farmer's name
Irrigation source and means must be available
required_documents: Aadhaar Card or Jan Aadhaar Card
Jamabandi copy not older than six months
application_process: Apply through Raj Kisan Sathi portal or nearby e-Mitra centre
construction_conditions: Administrative approval from Agriculture Department is required after application
Approval information is communicated through mobile message or Agriculture Supervisor
Physical verification before and after construction
Subsidy is deposited directly into the farmer's bank account
limitations: No separate government order or notification number is included in the snapshot
Current subsidy and eligibility must be verified against current official guidelines
Current financial year validity must be checked at query time
Do not infer tank dimensions or construction specifications not displayed
notes: Official Raj Kisan Sathi portal snapshot dated 31 October 2026. Preserve the minimum capacity, subsidy cap and eligibility wording accurately. Do not infer additional conditions.
